title: a signed-out visitor sees that something is happening, and is asked in to read it

criteria.text: An anonymous caller cannot retrieve an announcement body from the database, by any route
criteria.note: `page_posts` has no anonymous read (`to authenticated`); `announcements_withheld` has no body in its return type, re-created by #914 and #969 with the same grants [V migrations 20261018170000, 20261019143000]. Checked: `tests/announcements-signed-out-rest.test.ts` `[guards F093.1]` asks PostgREST with the publishable key; #218 records it failing on the pre-migration database [V PR body]. Reviewed no: #218 and #230 carry no `Reviewed by:` [V]. Shipped: deploy-health green on 75c682a8, 1fc06c8b, bfbbd619 [V]. Smoked unknown: the smoke does not call PostgREST.

criteria.text: The same is true of the start time and the place, and of any later column that carries them
criteria.note: Same policy; the return type has no `starts_at` or `location_id`; the new `kind` column (#969) is the Page's kind, not a time or place [V]. `[guards F093.2]` selects `starts_at, location_id` as anon and expects no rows; #906 ran it against a mutant anon policy and recorded the failure (`expected [...] to have a length of +0 but got 2`); the exact-column allow-list under F093.3 covers later columns [V]. Reviewed no: #218 and #230 carry no `Reviewed by:`; shipped yes (75c682a8, 1fc06c8b, bfbbd619). Smoked unknown (PostgREST).

criteria.text: Withholding is enforced in SQL: a projection that never selects the body, not a filter
criteria.note: `announcements_withheld` returns ten columns since #969: result_id, group_id, slug, name, public_id, photo_url, kind, announcement_count, announcement_ids, updated_at [V migration 20261019143000]. `[guards F093.3]` asserts that exact key set with a reason per column, watched failing in #230 and red on any further column (#969 body) [V]. Reviewed no: #218 and #230 carry no `Reviewed by:`; shipped yes (75c682a8, 19109a1e, b7766901, 1fc06c8b, bfbbd619). Smoked unknown (PostgREST).

criteria.text: The signed-out card carries exactly five things; a Page with no or a hidden photo shows its kind's default image
criteria.note: Photo, name, count with its period (a small-caps label on a scrim since #956), the details line and the sign-in call, with no body, time, place or Page location; since #969 (change #335, 2026-10-19) `mapWithheldRow` passes the Page's `kind` so a no-photo or hidden-photo card draws the kind's art [V `WithheldAnnouncementCard.tsx`, withheld-announcements.ts]. Checked yes: `[guards F093.4]` in `tests/f093-withheld-card-criteria.test.tsx` asserts the five things against real rows and now the art's `data-kind="group"`, red before the migration (`expected null to be 'group'`, #969 body); mutants for the card in #769 [V]. Reviewed no: #218, #230 no line; #969 has `Reviewed by: Claude (Explore lane)`. Shipped: green on 75c682a8, 19109a1e, bfbbd619 [V]. Smoked: smoke-live run 39977671049 on main cb892a75 (2026-10-23) was green and opened explore and page at 390 and 1280 signed out and as members; it loads the route, it does not tap [V]. #335 closed.

criteria.text: One card per Page, with the count and its period in words; a Page with none this period keeps its card without a nought
criteria.note: One row per Page (#230); label 'N posts this week', zero reads 'A new post'; the period follows `post_current_until` since #914 [V withheld-copy.ts]. `[guards F093.5]` (`tests/f093-withheld-card-criteria.test.tsx`) checks both against real rows, seen failing against mutants (#769) [V PR body]. Reviewed no: #218 and #230 carry no `Reviewed by:`; shipped yes (75c682a8, 19109a1e, 1fc06c8b). Smoked: smoke-live run 39977671049 on main cb892a75 (2026-10-23) was green and opened explore and page at 390 and 1280 signed out and as members; it loads the route, it does not tap [V].

criteria.text: A signed-in member sees no change whatsoever
criteria.note: `[guards F093.6]` in `tests/f093-front-door-guards.test.tsx` reads bodies, times, places, tags and order as a signed-in member through the real Page and Explore loaders and expects no withheld card; seen failing against 8 mutants (#770); #956 re-ran it against local Postgres [V]. Reviewed no (#218, #255); shipped yes (75c682a8, a7814ce9). Smoked: smoke-live run 39977671049 on main cb892a75 (2026-10-23) was green and opened explore and page at 390 and 1280 signed out and as members; it loads the route, it does not tap [V]. Caveat: Explore for members changed on purpose this week (#881, #932); this scenario's claim is about its own change only.

criteria.text: Signed-out Explore still contains post-kind rows, in withheld form
criteria.note: `loadBrowse` merges `getWithheldAnnouncements` into the signed-out mix, one card per Page in reach (#932), and since #906 the signed-out posts-only view lists the same withheld cards instead of 'Nothing here yet' [V load.ts]. Checked yes: `[guards F093.7]` in `tests/f093-signed-out-explore.test.tsx` (#906) loads Explore through the real `loadBrowse` as an anonymous caller, renders the real `BrowseSurface` and finds the withheld card with its sign-in call and no body in both views; failed on main before the fix and against two mutants [V PR body]. Reviewed no (#218 no line; #906 review-skipped). Shipped: green on 75c682a8, 7286b487, f8578fbb [V]. Smoked: smoke-live run 39977671049 on main cb892a75 (2026-10-23) was green and opened explore at 390 and 1280 for signed-out, stranger, member, owner and operator personas; it loads the route, it does not tap [V]. #844 closed 2026-10-18.

criteria.text: Signed-out front door: name, photo, description and the withheld card; no location, tags or founder; no map pins; indexable
criteria.note: `anon` loses `locations`, `anchor_location_id`, `page_tags`, `tags`; `browse_feed` returns null location, empty tags and no geography signed out; the reach's vantage never leaves the database (#932); quick links ride with the point so a signed-out card has none (#931); `?view=map&focus=` opens the map only signed in (#944); search signed out matches name and description only (#924, #934); `robots.ts` admits search crawlers [V]. `[guards F093.8]` in `tests/f093-front-door-guards.test.tsx` renders a signed-out Page and Explore card against real rows, plus `front-door-db.test.ts`, `member-reads-audit-db.test.ts` and `item-url.test.ts` [V]. Button reads 'Sign in to see what's happening' per the 2026-10-04 ruling (placeholder copy). Reviewed no (#255, #259 carry no `Reviewed by:`). Shipped unknown: no deploy-health run for 73625848 (#259) [V]. Smoked: smoke-live run 39977671049 on main cb892a75 (2026-10-23) was green and opened explore and page at 390 and 1280 signed out and as members; it loads the route, it does not tap [V].

criteria.text: An #announcement-<id> link, to any of the Page's announcements, lands on a page that resolves with the one card marked
criteria.note: `WithheldPagePosts` carries an anchor per announcement id; the database returns all ids for a Page (#230) [V]. `[guards F093.9]` renders the Page for the latest and an older id, expects one marked card with the sign-in call, no 404; seen failing against mutants (#769) [V]. Reviewed no (#230); shipped yes (19109a1e); smoked yes (run 39977671049 opens page signed out; it does not follow an anchor).

criteria.text: Nothing on the signed-out surface is a link to a body; the ask comes first
criteria.note: The sign-in call is its own link to `/auth/login?next=<Page>`; the card link goes only to the Page; signed-out cards carry no quick links (#931) [V `WithheldAnnouncementCard.tsx`]. `[guards F093.10]` collects every link on the signed-out Explore card and Page card and matches them against Page or sign-in only; seen failing against mutants (#769) [V]. Reviewed no (#218, #230); shipped yes; smoked yes (as 9).

criteria.text: The card is the same for every anonymous reader
criteria.note: Nothing on the withheld path reads a cookie, header, storage, clock or place; signed out the reach starts from the market's principal city, the same for everyone (#932) [V]. `[guards F093.11]` renders for two readers with different headers, timezones and cookies and expects identical output, and scans the path files for per-reader reads; seen failing against mutants (#770) [V]. Reviewed no (#218, #230); shipped yes; smoked yes.

criteria.text: Every criterion is discharged by a check that has been observed failing
criteria.note: Fail-first is now recorded for every criterion: 1 (#218), 2 and 7 (#906 mutants), 3 (#230), 4 (#969, red before the migration), 5, 9, 10 (#769 mutants), 6, 8, 11 (#770 mutants) [V PR bodies]. Checked no: nothing standing asserts that each of F093.1–11 carries a `[guards]` marker in a test file; `scripts/check-markers.sh` checks marker grammar only [V]. Reviewed no (#906 review-skipped, #769 and #770 review-skipped). Shipped: green on 7286b487, bfbbd619, fa202787, 288a5b86 [V]. Smoked unknown: not a route. #844 closed 2026-10-18. Filed #1017 (launch-blocking, Beta 11-06).
